review_evidence: Surveyed the checkout root (`find . -maxdepth 1`): `Algebra/`, `Crypto/`, `Examples/` are the Lean source directories in scope; `lakefile.toml`, `lake-manifest.json`, `lean-toolchain`, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `LICENSE` are non-Lean/out-of-scope files (no `lakefile.lean` present in this repository).

Ran a Lean declaration-marker grep (theorem|lemma|def |structure|inductive|class |instance|abbrev|macro|elab|syntax|axiom) across all 23 files: scores ranged from 2 (`Crypto/ZK/Binius.lean`) to 36 (`Algebra/Ring/Multilinear.lean`), with no zero-hit file.

Read the lowest-scoring file, `Crypto/ZK/Binius.lean`, in full (6723 bytes, 2 hits): a capstone file composing the whole boolean-circuit ZK argument (MLE, sumcheck, commitment) with a real `def andCircuit`, worked `example`s with `by decide`/`rw` proofs, and `#check` references into the theorems built across the other files -- genuine.

Read the next-lowest file, `Crypto/ZK/Sumcheck.lean`, in full (7989 bytes, 3 hits): the sumcheck protocol with real `example`s proving the Schwartz-Zippel soundness bound via `MvPolynomial.schwartz_zippel_totalDegree` with complete tactic proofs -- genuine.

Read `Algebra/Group/Cyclic.lean` in full (4866 bytes, 4 hits): cyclic-group examples/instances (`IsCyclic`, `orderOf`) with complete `by decide`/tactic proofs, including a multi-step `orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one`/`Nat.dvd_prime` proof -- genuine.

Read the head of `Examples/Sumcheck.lean` (8942 bytes, 4 hits): a worked end-to-end sumcheck run over ZMod 7 with a nonlinear round polynomial, under a `namespace Examples.Sumcheck` -- genuine, consistent with the file's role as a companion worked example.

No file matched a known exclusion pattern from this session's precedents (Lake/build config, pure import aggregator, generated data dump, exact duplicate, CI/editor tooling); every file in the unit carries real declarations or worked proofs specific to its algebraic/cryptographic topic, consistent with the prior review's retain disposition.
